title: Do Incentives to Review Help the Market? Evidence from a Field Experiment on Airbnb
eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. Randomized field experiment (listing-level assignment to a review-incentive coupon): feols(outcome ~ treatment) difference-in-means regressions (Tables 1, 2, 4, 5, 6) and IV with has_submitted instrumented by treatment (Tables 3-4). No unit-specific adoption dates or panel FE. The package ships simulated data only.
design_notes: R (fixest). Cross-sectional treatment-control comparisons, IV (has_submitted ~ treatment), and some columns with guest covariates.

specs.exclusion_reason: randomized experiment, cross-sectional OLS on treatment indicator and IV; no staggered adoption

data_files_note: README: simulated data for validating code; does not represent actual Airbnb data.
data_provenance_note: Simulated data shipped by the authors.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). RCT; synthetic data. Ineligible on design and data.
